subject.title: [Feature]: Allow job-level model override for cron jobs using sessionTarget=main + payload.kind=systemEvent

question: Should main-session `systemEvent` cron jobs gain a supported model/provider override contract, and should that contract be `payload.model`, top-level job fields, or a dedicated `sessionOverride` block?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix changes public cron schema, session/provider precedence, persistence shape, and upgrade behavior, so automation should not choose the API shape.

options.title: Extend `systemEvent` payloads
options.body: Allow `payload.model` and provider resolution for `systemEvent` cron payloads, matching the existing agent-turn style while adding main-session proof.

options.title: Add job-level overrides
options.body: Introduce top-level model/provider fields that apply across payload kinds, with a broader schema and migration/docs contract.

options.title: Keep `systemEvent` text-only
options.body: Document isolated `agentTurn` as the only supported per-job model path and leave main-session system events tied to session state.

recommendation.title: Extend `systemEvent` payloads
recommendation.body: Allow `payload.model` and provider resolution for `systemEvent` cron payloads, matching the existing agent-turn style while adding main-session proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across cron runtime, gateway cron, schema, and model-selection paths.
